root_cause.text: netem_enqueue() enforced sch->limit using only q->t_len, which tracks the internal tfifo length but not packets reordered into sch->q via __qdisc_enqueue_head, so reordering could let total queued packets exceed the qdisc limit.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state that “q->t_len only counts packets in the internal tfifo” while “Packets placed in sch->q by the reorder path (__qdisc_enqueue_head) are not counted,” and the patch fixes the check by changing `if (unlikely(q->t_len >= sch->limit))` to `if (unlikely(sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit))`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the netem enqueue limit check to use the qdisc queue length when determining whether the queue is full.
intent_record.what: In `netem_enqueue()`, the full-length check changed from testing `q->t_len >= sch->limit` to testing `sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the enqueue path now decides whether the qdisc is full based on the qdisc's actual queued packet count instead of the netem-specific `t_len` field, which can change when the limit condition triggers and packets are dropped.

candidates.rationale: This limit check only considers q->t_len, which tracks the internal tfifo length and can miss packets reordered into sch->q, allowing the total queued packets to exceed sch->limit.

vuln_statements.explanation: This enqueue-limit check is vulnerable because it enforces sch->limit using only q->t_len, which tracks the internal tfifo length and does not account for packets reordered into sch->q via __qdisc_enqueue_head. As a result, netem_enqueue() could admit more packets than the configured qdisc limit.

bic_trace_step.reason: The snippet clearly shows the vulnerable area and the fix. The root cause was that netem limited enqueue using the wrong queue length accounting: the old code checked `if (unlikely(sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit))`, which could include packets accounted from a child qdisc and not just the internal tfifo. In this commit, that check is changed to `if (unlikely(q->t_len >= sch->limit))`, and the added `u32 t_len;` plus `q->t_len++`/`q->t_len--` updates show the new internal counter for tfifo-only length. The dequeue path also decrements `sch->q.qlen` when packets come from the child qdisc (`if (skb) { sch->q.qlen--; goto deliver; }`), which is the fix described in the commit message. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present in the pre-fix logic shown by the diff context, but the code in this commit already contains the fix.
